Definition: Fraction of public naming requests with explicit recorded consent
Ratio of private/pseudonymous records reaching institutional review compared with public records, adjusted for submission completeness
Rights protection: Detects structural disadvantage caused by non-public participation

Definition: Time from dispute notice to accessible neutral review outcome
Rights protection: Measures due-process responsiveness, not claimant credibility

Definition: Fraction of corrected records that preserve a linked prior version and stated correction basis
Rights protection: Protects historical integrity and accountable changes

Definition: Fraction of prevention records with an explicit uncertainty statement
Rights protection: Prevents certainty inflation and hidden evidentiary gaps

Definition: Share of collaborative records that document enabling, accessibility, verification, maintenance, or stewardship contributions where present
Rights protection: Detects erasure of structurally necessary work

Definition: Count of records or policy outputs attempting final conferral, denial, revocation, or appeal disposition
Count of rejected prohibited sensitive fields without retaining their contents
Rights protection: Demonstrates data minimization without logging private data
